overview: Thailand is a country in South-East Asia. Its capital and largest city is Bangkok. Thailand is the only country in South-East Asia that was never colonised by a European power. It is a constitutional monarchy, most Thai people are Buddhist, and the country is famous for its food, temples and beaches.

geography.text: Northern Thailand is mountainous and forested. The centre is a fertile plain watered by the Chao Phraya river, one of the world's great rice-growing areas, and the north-east is a dry plateau. The south is a long, narrow peninsula with coasts on the Gulf of Thailand and the Andaman Sea, dotted with islands such as Phuket.

history.text: The kingdom of Sukhothai in the 1200s is often seen as the first Thai state, followed by Ayutthaya and, from 1782, the Chakri dynasty in Bangkok. Thailand, then called Siam, kept its independence while all its neighbours were colonised. It became a constitutional monarchy in 1932 and changed its name to Thailand in 1939.

events.title: Bangkok

events.title: Constitutional monarchy
events.text: A revolution ends absolute royal power.

government.text: Thailand is a constitutional monarchy. The King is highly respected, and criticising the monarchy is a serious crime. The Prime Minister leads the government. The army has staged many coups, most recently in 2014, and courts have removed several prime ministers.

economy.text: Thailand is a major manufacturer of cars and electronics and the world's biggest exporter of rice at times. Tourism is huge, with tens of millions of visitors a year.

culture.text: Thailand is a Buddhist country with thousands of temples, called wats. Thai food, such as pad thai and green curry, is popular worldwide. Songkran, the Thai New Year in April, is celebrated with a nationwide water fight. Thailand is the only country in South-East Asia never colonised by Europeans.

sport.text: Muay Thai, kickboxing using fists, elbows, knees and shins, is the national sport and is practised worldwide. Football, badminton and volleyball are also popular, and taekwondo has brought Olympic gold.
